facts.fact: 2024-10-01《The Londoner》@AroundTown 栏目报道：室内设计女王 Mimi Mott 宣布出售传奇庄园，并即将举办纪念品拍卖会 A Life in Objects。
facts.anchor: interiors queen Mimi Mott is selling her legendary estate, news of a forthcoming memorabilia auction, A Life in Objects

facts.fact: Mott 承认丈夫去世一年多以来几乎没离开上东区公寓。
facts.anchor: she has barely left her Upper East Side apartment since her husband died more than a year ago
She decamps to London next week.

facts.fact: 她靠品牌 Mimi's House 成名致富——之于八十年代室内设计，一如 Biba 之于六十年代时尚。
facts.anchor: Mott made her name – and her fortune – with Mimi’s House, the brand that was to eighties interiors what Biba was to sixties fashion

facts.fact: 拍卖会由 Mayfair 精品拍卖行 Lordats 主持，收益归慈善。
facts.anchor: A Life in Objects will be hosted by boutique Mayfair auctioneer Lordats, with proceeds going to charity

facts.fact: Mott 要招一名伦敦 Girl Friday：帮她决定什么放进拍卖、什么留下、什么藏起来。
facts.anchor: I also need a Girl Friday in London. Someone to help me decide what to put in, what to leave out, and what to hide, naturally.
